sources.observation: The slate-grey stone wall sits above the moat. A tall recessed arch frames the main entrance and the crossing spans the gap between the basins.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see image page
sources.observation: The long rectangular parapet surrounds a sunken roof field. Two pale raised roof volumes flank the green glass roof of the central court.

limitations: Roof heights, the arch profile, basin water heights and wall finish are reconstructed from published exterior images, PMTiles and the elevation grid. The asset covers the NGV International main building.
